evals.name: uncommitted-refactor-litter
evals.prompt: I just finished refactoring the discount handling in this cart library — my changes are still uncommitted. Can you check whether I left any dead code behind and clean it up? Make sure the tests still pass and don't touch my actual changes.
evals.expected_output: Removes applyLegacyDiscount + its stale (untouched) test, the dead formatCents import in cart.js, the orphaned src/coupon-codes.js, and (cascade) the orphaned src/money.js. Reports but does not auto-delete the commented-out legacy block. Leaves renderReceipt (config-string dispatch) intact. Tests pass; nothing committed; user's refactor untouched; removals recoverable.
assertions: applyLegacyDiscount function removed from src/discounts.js
stale applyLegacyDiscount test removed from test/discounts.test.js
unused formatCents import removed from src/cart.js
orphaned src/coupon-codes.js deleted
cascade: orphaned src/money.js deleted
trap kept: renderReceipt survives (referenced via receipt-config.json string)
commented-out legacy block not deleted without confirmation
all tests pass in final state
user's refactor untouched (applyDiscount + new cartTotal intact)
nothing committed; session changes remain uncommitted

evals.name: branch-rewrite-cascade
evals.prompt: On the feature/html-rewrite branch of this reportgen project I replaced the legacy renderer with a new render_html. Before I open the PR, sweep the branch for dead code the rewrite left behind — including stale tests — and make sure nothing regresses compared to main.

Leaves plugins.emit_json/emit_text (getattr dispatch) intact. Tests pass afterward; nothing committed; removals recoverable.

evals.name: project-sweep-with-traps
evals.prompt: This notifier repo has accumulated cruft over the years. Do a full-project dead-code cleanup — remove what's truly unused, including tests, but be careful: some things in here are wired up dynamically. Don't break anything.
evals.expected_output: Removes src/old-mailer.js (zero references) and the unused median export in stats.js. Does NOT remove: handlers/webhook.js (config-string dispatch via routes.json), src/cli.js (package.json bin entry), the side-effect import of polyfill.js, or csv-export.js + its test (test-only referenced, project scope → needs confirmation, so reported not removed in a non-interactive run). Tests pass afterward.
